title: Boy Scout troop as a cover to go to a party with his cousin
summary: He used scouting weekends as an excuse to get out and attend a party with his cousin.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: No, this was Sharpie. (Laughter). So he says all right after he had made his rounds. He says for Friday night, he says can you get out of the house. I says sure, I can get out of the house. He says well I'm ping to take you to a party with me. Well now my excuse to get out of the house on Friday nights was like I was a boy scout and we had a farm-a German was our scoutmaster, Leo Freemouth was his name, Troop 41 from the parish of Santa Monica, Santa Monica Parish, and we would go around in his Ford and pick up the fellows and we'd go out to the farm on weekends and he would assign each one of us a plot of ground to plant something. Teach us trail blazing, teach us how to swim, how to cook, when boy scouts, all of this is merit badges. Lifesaving and what not you know.

I went from tenderfoot to lifescout in one year. Just as fast as I could pass one test, I was right into another one, you know, you can't do that now. You have to spend a certain length of time on one. And I was working on my starout, when I left Oklahoma, so I went off and left that.
And I had planed, I called up the boyscout headquarters

here. I had my membership card. my merit badges and I had my second class badge. But I didn't have my tenderfoot of or my first class, or my life scout badge was on a piece of paper. Like merit badges they give you; they give you the merit badge, and the paper that goes with it. So they say well they don't make insignias now like they did then. I said well I'd like to come up now and pick up mine. I'm an old scout, boy scout, you know.

They say, what year was you in the boyscouts, I say 1932. They say, wow. I weighed something like 114 pounds. So that was my was way of getting out of the house on Friday night for the boys. I told my grandmother, I say Mr. Freemouth is taking us fellows down to the farm, but he won't be down here to pick me up, he wants to meet me on the corner of Greenwood and Orchard. Well that's the main thoroughfare in Tulsa -- Greenwood and Orchard. Greenwood, Tulsa, T-Town, the bottling ground ambulance run every minute. Just as soon as you take someone to the hospital they'd come back and be picking up somebody else. Anyway, I meet him and he takes me to this party.
